title: AgentTab challenge event
description: Proposed in ADR 0002. Describes one active or just-ended bot challenge episode on a task-owned tab. Returned as the optional `challenge` member of browser_open, browser_snapshot, browser_act, and browser_wait results, and in challenge error details. Contains no page text, URL path or query, sitekey, or response token.

challenge_id.description: Random episode identifier. Stable while the same signature stays active on the tab, including across interstitial self-reloads.

page_revision.description: Revision at which this observation was made.

first_page_revision.description: Revision at which the episode was first detected.

page_origin.description: Origin of the top-level document. Never includes a path, query, or fragment.

vendor.description: Catalog vendor identifier, for example cloudflare, google_recaptcha, hcaptcha, aws_waf, or generic.

product.description: Catalog product identifier, for example challenge_page, turnstile, or recaptcha_v2.

kind.description: interstitial: the whole document is a challenge page. widget: an embedded gate inside an otherwise usable page. puzzle: an interactive task is displayed. block: a denial with no challenge path. rate_limit: a throttling response.

interaction.description: automatic: expected to clear without input in a real profile. human: needs a person. none: no interaction can clear it.

state.description: active: the gate is present and blocking. cleared: the gate passed on the same surface. superseded: the tab left the challenge without clearing it, for example by navigating elsewhere. Kind, product, and interaction may change within one active episode, such as a widget opening a puzzle.

confidence.description: high: a vendor-documented marker matched. medium: a catalog DOM or frame heuristic matched. low: a generic heuristic matched.

token_present.description: Widget only. True when the catalog-named response field is non-empty. The value itself is never read into a result.

next.description: Detector-derived next step. none only when state is not active.

wait_budget_ms.description: Remaining automatic-clear budget. Required when next is wait.

notice_id.description: Open attention notice whose completion references this challenge, when one exists.

probe.description: debugger: frame tree and main-document response metadata from an already attached task session. scripting: isolated-world read of the top document only.
